in_marathi.name: Nagin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who holds, protects, or represents the power and mystery of a snake or serpent. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nagini', meaning 'female serpent'.
